pages.text: 早上，咘咘穿鞋子，穿了好几次都穿不上。她的小嘴嘟起来，脚跺了一下。妈妈说：“鞋子不听话，是有点生气，对不对？”
pages.text_en: In the morning, Bubu tried her shoes again and again, but they would not go on. Her little mouth pouted and her foot stamped. Mummy said, "The shoes will not listen. That feels a bit angry, right?"

pages.text: 下午，咘咘搭了一座高高的积木塔。NOMI 递积木，NONO 数数：“一、二、三。”塔晃了一下，哗啦全倒了。
pages.text_en: In the afternoon, Bubu built a tall block tower. NOMI passed her blocks, NONO counted, "One, two, three." The tower wobbled and crashed down.

pages.text: 咘咘的胸口紧紧的，脸热热的，手紧紧握着。她大声说：“我不要玩了！”积木滚得到处都是。
pages.text_en: Bubu's chest felt tight, her face felt hot, and her hands clenched. She shouted, "I don't want to play anymore!" Blocks rolled everywhere.

pages.text: 晚上，妈妈切了一块蛋糕给咘咘。咘咘刚拿到手，蛋糕啪嗒掉到了地上。她愣住了，眼泪一下子涌出来。
pages.text_en: At night, Mummy cut a piece of cake for Bubu. Just as Bubu took it, the cake plopped onto the floor. She froze, and tears rushed out.

pages.text: 咘咘跑去找妈妈：“妈妈抱抱！”妈妈正在忙，手上都是水，说：“等妈妈一下，妈妈现在抱不了。”咘咘哭得更大声了。
pages.text_en: Bubu ran to Mummy. "Mummy, hug me!" Mummy was busy, her hands wet. "Wait a moment, Mummy cannot hug you right now." Bubu cried even louder.

pages.text: NOMI、NONO 和 Coco 没有走开，他们安静地陪在她身边。妈妈忙完，蹲下来抱住咘咘：“哭是可以的，我在这里。想要的事情没达成，是很生气，对不对？”
pages.text_en: NOMI, NONO and Coco did not walk away. They stayed quietly beside her. When Mummy finished, she crouched down and hugged Bubu. "Crying is okay. I am here. When what you want does not happen, it feels very angry, right?"

pages.text: 咘咘吸了一下鼻子说：“我很生气，因为鞋子穿不上，塔倒了，蛋糕掉了，还不能马上抱抱。”她把生气的原因，一件一件说出来了。
pages.text_en: Bubu sniffed. "I am angry, because my shoes would not go on, my tower fell, my cake dropped, and I could not get a hug at once." She said each angry reason, one by one.

pages.text: 妈妈说：“说出来了，真好。”咘咘按了一下手掌，小声说：“暂停一下。”她闻一闻花，再慢慢把气吹出来，像吹生日蜡烛一样。
pages.text_en: "Saying it out loud is so good," Mummy said. Bubu pressed her palm and said softly, "Pause for a moment." She smelled a flower and blew out slowly, like blowing out birthday candles.

pages.text: 咘咘的呼吸慢下来了，胸口也不那么紧了。她小声说：“我还想再搭一次塔，这次搭得慢一点。蛋糕掉了，妈妈可以再切一块吗？”
pages.text_en: Bubu's breathing slowed down, and her chest did not feel so tight. She said softly, "I want to build the tower again, more slowly this time. The cake dropped. Mummy, can you cut another piece?"

pages.text: 妈妈切了一小块蛋糕，咘咘小心地捧着。NOMI 递积木，NONO 数数，Coco 说：“Slowly, slowly！慢慢来！”塔又立起来了，虽然没有刚才那么高。
pages.text_en: Mummy cut a small piece of cake, and Bubu held it carefully. NOMI passed the blocks, NONO counted, and Coco said, "Slowly, slowly!" The tower stood up again, even though it was not as tall as before.

pages.text: 咘咘想起以前摔倒了自己爬起来的事，笑着说：“摔倒了可以爬起来，塔倒了也可以再搭。”妈妈点点头：“生气的时候，先停住，再说出来，再试一次。”
pages.text_en: Bubu remembered getting up by herself after falling, and smiled. "When I fall, I can get up. When a tower falls, I can build it again." Mummy nodded. "When you are angry, pause first, say it out loud, then try again."

pages.text: 咘咘知道，生气还会来，想要的事情还会不成。没关系，下一次，她可以更早停住、说出来，再慢慢想办法。
pages.text_en: Bubu knew anger would come again, and wanted things would sometimes not happen. That was okay. Next time, she could pause earlier, say it out loud, and then slowly think of a way.
